editorialSummary.heading: Fall break, hurricane make-up days and Chalo Nitka
paragraphs: Glades County students start school Monday, August 10, 2026. Open House is August 6: Moore Haven Elementary and West Glades School share the listed 5:00–7:00 time slot, while Moore Haven Middle-High School is listed for 6:00–8:00. Fall break runs October 12–16, and classes resume Monday, October 19. The published Thanksgiving holidays run November 23–27, but November 23–25 may be used as hurricane make-up days if needed. November 26–27 remain holidays.

Winter break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday with no students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 5. Friday, March 5 is Chalo Nitka, a longstanding local festival in Moore Haven, and the calendar marks no school for students or teachers. Spring break runs March 22–26, followed by a teacher workday on March 29. Students return Tuesday, March 30.
Senior families have two dates in May: baccalaureate on Sunday, May 16, and graduation on Friday, May 21. The district's annual calendar does not give ceremony times or venues.

Friday, May 28, 2027, is the last regular student day and the calendar's early-release date. Students attend but leave early. The annual calendar does not give a dismissal time, so families should check their school's pickup and bus arrangements.
highlights: Fall break runs October 12–16, 2026; classes resume October 19.
November 23–25 may become hurricane make-up days. November 26–27 remain holidays.
Students return January 5 and March 30, 2027, after teacher workdays.
May 28 is the last student day, with early release.

about.processing: The complete page was checked as extracted text and as a rendered image. Yellow marks school days, green no teachers/no students, red holidays, orange conditional hurricane make-up days and purple early release. March 5 Chalo Nitka is green; May 28 is the only purple student day, and December 18 remains yellow. Only November 23-25 are conditional, not all Thanksgiving holidays or any other break. Split the original November 23-27 range into the explicit make-up range, Thanksgiving Day and November 27 without duplicate attendance dates. The 210 weekdays between August 10 and May 28 minus 29 fixed and three scheduled conditional no-class weekdays reconcile to the printed 178. Quarter totals 44/39/51/44 and semesters 83/95 also agree. Named breaks stay separate from derived continuous spans and January/March teacher workdays. Open house is one occurrence with campus-specific times exactly as printed; the source does not specify a.m./p.m. for those entries. Senior ceremonies are milestones, including the Sunday baccalaureate, not extra student attendance dates or school closures. No senior last-attendance date, final report-card date or early-release clock is inferred. Pre-year staff reporting/learning, post-year teacher workdays and Memorial Day after the last student day are excluded. The 188 Day Calendar heading and 196-day employee line do not replace the explicit 178 student-day figure. The PDF prints no approval or revision date, and its stale metadata title July 2004 and creation timestamp are not publication evidence. Direct Google download timed out before and after an approved retry; the local SHA-256 is recorded without asserting remote byte identity. Previous-year hours and December 19, 2025 early-release bus notices are not transferred to this school year.

faqs.question: When does school start in Glades County for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The first day for students is Monday, August 10, 2026. Teacher reporting and preparation dates before August 10 are not student attendance days.

faqs.question: When is the 2026 Glades County Schools Open House?
faqs.answer: Open House is Thursday, August 6, 2026. Moore Haven Elementary and West Glades School are listed at 5:00–7:00, and Moore Haven Middle-High School at 6:00–8:00. The district calendar does not specify a.m. or p.m., so confirm the time and arrival details with your school.

faqs.question: Which schools follow the Glades County student calendar?
faqs.answer: The calendar covers the district's regular student year, including Moore Haven Elementary, Moore Haven Middle-High School and West Glades School. If your child attends a program with a separate schedule, confirm its dates directly.

faqs.question: When is fall break in Glades County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall break runs Monday, October 12 through Friday, October 16, 2026. With the surrounding weekends, students are away from regular classes October 10–18 and return Monday, October 19.

faqs.question: Is the whole Thanksgiving week off in Glades County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. The calendar schedules Thanksgiving holidays for November 23–27, but November 23–25 may be used as hurricane make-up days if needed. November 26–27 remain holidays. Regular classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: Which dates are possible hurricane make-up days in 2026?
faqs.answer: November 23, 24 and 25, 2026 are the three listed hurricane make-up dates. The calendar does not say which would be used first or when a decision would be announced. Check district and school messages after any weather-related closure.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do Glades County students return in January 2027?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday with no students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 5. Including weekends, students are away from regular classes December 19 through January 4.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and when do students return in March 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 22–26, 2027. Students also have Monday, March 29 off for a teacher workday and return Tuesday, March 30. With the surrounding weekends, students have ten consecutive days away from regular classes, March 20–29.

faqs.question: Is there school on Chalo Nitka, March 5, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, March 5, 2027 is a day off for both students and teachers on the district calendar. Chalo Nitka is Moore Haven's longstanding local festival.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays have no classes for students?
faqs.answer: During the student school year, Monday, January 4 and Monday, March 29, 2027 are listed as Teacher Work Day (No Students). They come immediately before the winter and spring return dates.

faqs.question: Are Glades County schools closed on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, September 7, 2026 is a Labor Day holiday with no student classes.

faqs.question: Is there school in Glades County on Veterans Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is listed as a Veterans Day holiday with no student classes.

faqs.question: Is Martin Luther King Jr. Day a school holiday in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Glades County students have no classes on Monday, January 18, 2027, for Martin Luther King Jr. Day.

faqs.question: Do Glades County students have school on Presidents' Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, February 15, 2027 is a Presidents' Day holiday with no student classes.

faqs.question: What is the last day of school in Glades County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027 is the last day on the district's regular student calendar. Students have early release that day, and it also marks the end of the fourth nine weeks and second semester.

faqs.question: Which early-release days are listed for 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: May 28, 2027 is the only date specifically marked Early Release for Students ONLY on the published calendar. It is still a student attendance day. Check school notices for any subsequent schedule changes.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal on May 28, 2027?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar marks May 28 for early release but does not give a dismissal time. Check your school's instructions and transportation notices for the release and bus schedules.

faqs.question: Is December 18, 2026 an early-release day?
faqs.answer: No early release is marked for December 18 on the 2026–2027 calendar. It is a regular school day that ends the second nine weeks and first semester. May 28 is the only listed student early-release date.

faqs.question: When do progress reports go home in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 10 and November 12, 2026, and February 5 and April 23, 2027.

faqs.question: When are report cards sent home in Glades County?
faqs.answer: The published dates are October 22, 2026, January 8, 2027 and April 1, 2027. The calendar does not specify when final fourth-quarter report cards will be issued.

faqs.question: When do the four grading periods end in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The nine-week grading periods end October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 19 and May 28, 2027. A grading-period ending does not automatically mean students have the day off.

faqs.question: When do the first and second semesters end?
faqs.answer: The first semester ends Friday, December 18, 2026, and the second semester ends Friday, May 28, 2027. The final day includes early release for students.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are scheduled in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists 178 student days: 83 in the first semester and 95 in the second. That total comes from the student attendance line, not the separate employee-day figures.

faqs.question: Why does the calendar say 188 days if students have 178 days?
faqs.answer: The document includes an 188 Day Calendar heading, but its last-student-day entry explicitly states 178 Days. The semester totals of 83 and 95 also add up to 178. The 188-day heading should not be used as the student attendance total.

faqs.question: When is the 2027 baccalaureate ceremony for seniors?
faqs.answer: Baccalaureate is listed for Sunday, May 16, 2027. The district calendar does not provide a ceremony time or venue. Check senior-class announcements for details.

faqs.question: When is graduation for Glades County seniors in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists senior-class graduation for Friday, May 21, 2027. It does not include a ceremony time or location. Check the school's senior announcements for those details.

faqs.question: Is May 21, 2027 the last school day for seniors?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists graduation on May 21 but does not specify a separate final attendance date for seniors. May 28 is the last day on the regular student calendar. Confirm senior attendance requirements with the school.

faqs.question: What time do Glades County schools start and dismiss students in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The district's 2026–2027 student calendar does not list daily bell times. Check the current schedule for Moore Haven Elementary, Moore Haven Middle-High School or West Glades School for arrival, dismissal and transportation details.

faqs.question: Where can I view the official Glades County Schools 2026–2027 calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: On the district's Calendars page, open the 2026–2027 section and select School Calendar. The link opens a Google Drive file. Make sure you choose the student calendar rather than one of the separate employee calendars.
